realtime.notice.audioUnsupported: This browser has no AudioContext, so audio cannot be captured.
realtime.notice.resampled: The browser refused a 16 kHz AudioContext; falling back to {rate} Hz and resampling in the worklet.
realtime.notice.noMic: Could not open the microphone: {detail}. System audio is an alternative, or try another browser.
realtime.notice.shareHint: Tick the share-system-audio box when sharing, or share the meeting tab itself.
realtime.notice.needSource: At least one input (microphone or system audio) is needed to start.
realtime.notice.wsClosed: The connection to the service dropped.
errors.retranscribe_unavailable: This deployment has no backend configured for re-running a session.
realtime.speaker.applyToAll: Apply to every segment from this speaker
errors.session_busy: This session is still recording — stop it before re-running.
realtime.hint.idle: Not started yet — pick an input (microphone or system audio), then press Start.
realtime.hint.warmingUp: Filling the first window: the model needs at least 8 seconds of audio before it runs once, so the screen stays empty for a moment. That is normal.
realtime.hint.waiting: A window has run; waiting for the first stable text to commit — a few more seconds by default.
realtime.hint.silentWindows: {count} windows were skipped as silence: almost no audio in them was above the silence threshold. Check the microphone selection and mute state, or whether system audio is connected at all.
realtime.hint.degraded: The transcription backend has failed {count} times in a row and is retrying. See the red banner below and the service log.
realtime.notice.degraded: The transcription backend keeps failing and is retrying — no new text until it recovers.
realtime.notice.overloaded: Transcription is {lag}s behind real time and is still catching up: text keeps arriving, but late. If this holds, the backend needs more compute.
realtime.hint.micSilent: The microphone is sending nothing but zeros: the device opened, but every frame is silent. This is what an OS-level microphone permission (Windows Settings -> Privacy -> Microphone), the wrong input device, or an unplugged headset looks like. Switch device or fix the permission, then start again.
realtime.notice.micSilent: The microphone is delivering digital silence - check the OS microphone permission and the input device.
